d: Anthropic's IPO on November 19 has made most of the company's employees millionaires. Around 5,100 Anthropic employees are now worth at least $1 Million. About 600 of them are now centi-millionaires, which means they have a net worth of at least $100 Million. Meanwhile, Youth-led protests are erupting across at least 25 European nations. Young protesters from across Europe are coordinating to conduct continent wide demonstrations this weekend. The protests have already begun, with a confrontation seen between young protesters and the riot police in Italy's capital, Rome. Hem Kaur Saroya…
